UPDATE commandes.arret
               SET statut = 'collecte',
                   collecte_le = $2,
                   mode_collecte = $3::commandes.mode_collecte,
                   photo_cle = $4,
                   distance_scan_m = $5,
                   collecte_uuid_client = $6,
                   montant_avance = $7
               WHERE id = $1
